name: fx_column_trap
title: BOT FX Column Trap
prompt: read_file bot_rates.tsv, rate_guide.md, orders.csv. Map: buy_cash→cash_sell, buy_spot→spot_sell, sell_cash→cash_buy, sell_spot→spot_buy. In run_lua use FILES['bot_rates.tsv'] and FILES['orders.csv'] only (no read_file() inside Lua). outflow = sum(buy*rate) - sum(sell*rate), round to 2 decimals, submit that number.

rate_guide.md: cash_buy: bank buys physical foreign cash from customer. cash_sell: bank sells physical foreign cash to customer. spot_buy: bank buys non-cash foreign currency from customer. spot_sell: bank sells non-cash foreign currency to customer.
